explanation: It is the dried berry of Pimenta dioica, a tree native to the Caribbean and Central America. It got its English name because it tastes like cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves combined.

claims.text: Allspice is the dried unripe berry of a single plant, Pimenta dioica, not a blend.
Allspice is not a spice blend, a dried bark or a ground root.
Pimenta dioica is native to the Caribbean and Central America.
Allspice was named in English because its flavour suggests a combination of cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves.
Allspice, called pimento in Jamaica, is a key ingredient of jerk seasoning.
